author: Yihui Xie
html:
Big thanks to the DataScienceLA team for the hard work! It was my great honor to be interviewed at useR! 2014. This blog post has accurately summarized what I was thinking about. Nice job!

This was my first ever video interview. As a shy person, fortunately I did not blush or tremble, but I'm a little bit annoyed by my endless mmhmm's during the conversation :) Next time I will try to stay quiet while the other person is talking.

author: Laurent
html: Great interview, Yihui, thanks! And don't worry about mmhmm'ing; people appreciate honesty, dedication and honesty, that's what makes a difference.

author: Eduardo Ariño de la Rubia
html: You know, I feel bad that I interrupted you when we were talking about the animate package! I just got so excited :) I wish I would have let you keep answering!
